$comment: Everything the player reads rather than walks on: glyphs, economy icons, parcel markers and
UI CHROME WEARS FORGE WORLDS' ACCENT #6d9a49 (doc 23 §1.1), as Emberkin and Aetherholm both
do (ui/packages/ui/src/surfaces.ts and :477) — a title wears its product's colour rather
than claiming its own. The glyphs and icons are therefore the only FLAT VECTOR work in an
otherwise painterly repository, and verify.py holds them to an accent-coverage floor that the
`pending` and `available` are not decoration. The economy shows a pending balance and an
available balance as two separate figures (§8.2) and they must be distinguishable at 16px by
someone who cannot tell the two accent colours apart — so the distinction below is carried by
SHAPE (an open ring against a filled disc), never by hue.
